questions.prompt: In the run, why did the program look in the docs folder?
options: The code tells it to look in docs when a file is missing
The step limit sends it there
The model read the results of list_files and chose to look there
readFile searches every folder by itself
questions.explanation: The program only runs what the model asks for. The model read the error and the file lists, and chose docs/notes.txt.

questions.prompt: The model keeps asking for tools and never answers in text. What does the first agent do?
options: It stops after 10 steps and returns a note that it stopped
It asks the user to press a key
questions.explanation: MAX_STEPS is 10, so the for loop ends after 10 steps and returns the note. This caps the requests one turn can make.

questions.prompt: list_files throws because a folder does not exist. What does the model get in the next request?
options: A tool_result with the same call id, the error text and is_error true
questions.explanation: The loop catches the exception and sends it back as a tool error result, so the model can try another path.
